sections.title: Section 2: Reading Comprehension
sections.passageText:
In recent years, modern organizations across the globe have begun transforming their operational dynamics to meet higher environmental standards. Beyond simply reducing paper consumption or turning off office lights, forward-thinking businesses are integrating sustainability directly into employee training and career development programs...

Last year, GreenTech Solutions—a medium-sized firm specializing in renewable energy consulting—launched a campus-wide initiative known as the 'Green Skills Development Program.' Under this initiative, every team member must complete twenty hours of eco-friendly operational training annually. Employees learn how to evaluate carbon footprints, streamline resource usage, and utilize digital communication tools rather than commuting across town for short face-to-face meetings...

'When we introduced this policy, some employees worried it would increase their daily workload,' explains HR Director Layla Benzine. 'However, as workers adapted to the new digital workflows, they realized that these habits actually saved them hours of travel time every week. In fact, total productivity rose by fifteen percent during the first six months.'...

Furthermore, the initiative actively rewards professional initiative. Staff members who propose practical sustainability projects receive company funding to implement their ideas on campus. If a team develops an eco-friendly process that reduces office waste by more than twenty percent, they are awarded professional development grants to attend international conferences...

Ultimately, GreenTech Solutions demonstrates that continuous environmental education does not just benefit local ecosystems—it also equips employees with modern, marketable skills necessary for career advancement in a rapidly changing economy.

questions.text: What is the primary objective of the article?
options: To explain why face-to-face business meetings are completely ineffective.
To illustrate how integrating green initiatives into employee training improves both sustainability and productivity.
To criticize employees who refuse to adapt to new workplace software.
To compare GreenTech Solutions with other international consulting firms.

questions.text: According to the passage, how many hours of annual eco-friendly training must GreenTech employees complete?
Based on the text, which of the following statements is TRUE?
options: Employee productivity dropped significantly after the green initiative was introduced.
Employees who successfully reduce workplace waste can earn grants for international conferences.
GreenTech Solutions forces all staff members to work from home permanently.
Layla Benzine was opposed to the new environmental training program from the beginning.

questions.text: In paragraph 2, what does the word 'streamline' most nearly mean in the phrase 'streamline resource usage'?
options: To make an organization or system more efficient and organized.
To increase the financial cost of operational materials.
To completely eliminate all technology from the workplace.
To postpone important business decisions until next year.

questions.text: In paragraph 3, what does the word 'they' refer to in the phrase 'they realized that these habits...'?
Read this sentence adapted from paragraph 4: 'If a team develops an eco-friendly process, they will receive professional development grants.' What grammatical structure is used in this sentence?
options: Passive Voice in the Past Simple
First Conditional for real future possibilities
